title: Mandibular Slotplates
brief_summary: A new osteosynthesis system for orthognathic surgery was proposed.This system allows small intra-operative adjustments of the bone fragments during the osteosynthesis phase of the operation (also known as the slot principle). Another possible advantage are the slant screw holes with chamfered ridges allowing easy placements of the screws via the small incision wound without undercuts in between the plate and the screwheads.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Patients undergoing single osteotomy BSSO surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

• Concomitant surgeries at the same time.
